name: Portal stays up
ownerWords:
do we have api portal staging? your job is PM for api portal

wait but engage crawl not working?
goal: A customer who calls api.virev.ai never hits a dead portal or a dead crawler behind it. Every prod api probe target (crawler /health, crawler /health/schema, portal /openapi.json) passes now and passed all of the last 24 h, and the newest probe is under 15 min old, so the Convex probe itself is still running.

metrics.label: Prod api probe targets failing now (crawler health, crawler schema, openapi)
Share of prod api probes that passed over 24 h, all three targets
Age of the newest prod api probe
Probe queries the precheck could not read from Grafana

onMiss: Read the flagged rows. crawler_health or crawler_schema means the crawler behind the portal; portal_openapi means api.virev.ai. Follow ops/runbooks/api-portal-probe-down.md in auto-sns-agent, or api-portal-probe-stale.md for a stale probe, a series_missing or a source_error row (check the Convex cron "api health probe" and the api-portal-health scrape first). A portal outage gets one fix job here unless one is live; it fixes on staging (c50) and asks the chat for any prod promote. A crawler outage goes to the chat as a note for the crawler-v3 owner with the target, error class and time; do not patch the crawler from the portal side. A past failure that recovered: find when and why from api_probe_up and note it under p1. No outside sends (c37), no merges (c49). Tell the owner when a prod target is down now. All on target: end the turn with no message.
